# Bournemouth v Leeds  (31/10/2026)

FavoritesSoccerPSLRugby UnionTennisGolfCricketBasketballDarts

A trip to the south coast to face an in-form Bournemouth represents a less-than-ideal game for a Leeds side trending in the opposite direction to their hosts.

## Match News and Current Form [...] Bournemouth’s Rayan was on target against Manchester United last weekend, though that was the only one of his six Premier League goals to arrive in the first half. Dominic Calvert-Lewin is another who grows into games, scoring after the break in seven of his last eight Premier League scoring appearances.

Bournemouth have no fresh concerns, while Leeds hope to welcome Nico Elvedi back after he missed last weekend’s game.

For all the latest team news, please check the Flashscore match centre. [...] Leeds have only lost once in the Premier League this season (W2, D5), but they’re also winless in four such outings (D3, L1) as the momentum gained from a quick start looks to have waned somewhat. That shouldn’t leave them feeling despondent though, as this season has still brought about their best eight-game start to a top-flight season since 2002/03, but returning to winning ways on the road looks a tall order for a side who’ve won just two of their last 20 league road trips (D11, L7).
